correctness.rationale: The Heawood incidence graph from seven Fano triples is connected with 14 vertices, 21 edges and 8-dimensional cycle space. Switching fixes 13 spanning-tree signs, leaving exactly 2^8=256 signings; fixing one spin leaves exactly 2^13=8192 distinct cuts per signing. Even-subgraph parity and girth 6 yield M0=1, M2=21, M4=1281, M6=126021+720 c6 and M8=16784481+20160(17 c6+2 c8), odd moments zero. A fresh independent exhaustive program enumerated all 256 switching classes and 8192 spin-cut representatives for each, with 28 hexagons and 21 octagons, and recovered seven distinct (c6,c8,L, DOS) rows with multiplicities 28,56,24,84,42,21,1. Specifically c6=0 has L=3 for c8=-7 and L=2 for c8=1, proving moments ≤7 insufficient; (M6,M8) distinguish all seven full DOS vectors so order8 suffices. The finite proof is exhaustive because the spanning-tree and cut-space reductions establish both search domains.
